issues.title: Asset pipeline: real GLB socket + budget validate
issues.body:
## Intent
Replace the asset-pipeline validate stub with real checks: GLB file exists, named sockets match `SOCKETS_BY_SLOT` for the part’s Fetz-slot, and a triangle/byte budget gate — fail with exit code 1 so CI/local can catch bad parts.

## User Journey
1. Author runs `npm run asset:validate -- v3-part-water-traeger-01`
2. System reports DE/EN status (sockets, size, registry)
3. Author sees exit 0 on pass, exit 1 on missing GLB / bad sockets / over budget

## Problem
`tools/asset-pipeline/validate.mjs` always exits 0; docs mark socket/budget checks as follow-up. Placeholder GLBs cannot be gated.

## Solution
Extend `tools/asset-pipeline/validate.mjs` (and docs in `docs/engine-system/asset-pipeline.md`): parse GLB (or lightweight glTF JSON chunk) for node/socket names aligned with `src/services/engineAssets/slotSockets.ts`; enforce file-size and optional triangle budget; keep usage exit 2. No Meshy, no network, no secrets.

## Runtime
| Axis | This slice |
|------|------------|
| Local (desktop) | yes |
| Cloud session | no |
| Appwrite Functions | skip |

## Edge Cases
- Unknown asset id → fail (exit 1), not silent 0
- Path-traversal ids still rejected (exit 2)
- Preview PNG still optional

## Acceptance
- [ ] `npm run asset:validate -- <known-id>` exits 0 only when GLB exists and required sockets present under budget
- [ ] Missing/invalid GLB or sockets → exit 1 with clear DE/EN message
- [ ] `docs/engine-system/asset-pipeline.md` documents real checks (stub note removed)
- [ ] `npm run checks` still green; no Three.js in `src/game/`
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (`@typed-strict` / Boy Scout)

## Design
Epic: `.qa/design/fetz-v3-production-followups.md`

## Runner
Labels: P0, agent-ready
Feature slug: `fetz-asset-validate-real`

issues.title: Ship pilot real GLBs for MVP trio parts
dependsOn: Asset pipeline: real GLB socket + budget validate
issues.body:
## Intent
Replace placeholder box GLBs for the documented MVP trio with distinctive real meshes that pass `asset:validate` and assemble correctly in `WeaponAssembler` / Play preview.

## User Journey
1. Player opens Engine-Preview for a build using the pilot parts
2. System loads GLBs that are visually distinct per slot (Träger / Antrieb / Aufsatz)
3. Player sees assembled weapon, not three identical unit boxes

## Problem
All 36 `public/engine-parts/mvp/*.glb` are ~1 KB placeholders. Mass replace is out of scope; need a prove-out path.

## Solution
Author/export three GLBs only: `v3-part-water-traeger-01`, `v3-part-shadow-antrieb-01`, `v3-part-light-aufsatz-01` (see `docs/engine-system/rendering.md`). Named sockets per `SOCKETS_BY_SLOT`. Bump registry `version` or document asset version for those ids. Hand-authored / script-generated meshes OK — Meshy not required. Leave other 33 as placeholders.

## Runtime
| Axis | This slice |
|------|------------|
| Local (desktop) | yes |
| Cloud session | no |
| Appwrite Functions | skip |

## Edge Cases
- Non-pilot parts still load placeholders without crash
- `asset:validate` must pass for all three pilot ids
- Assembler socket parenting unchanged for non-pilot builds

## Acceptance
- [ ] Three pilot GLBs committed under `public/engine-parts/mvp/` and pass `npm run asset:validate`
- [ ] Visually distinct from unit-box placeholders in Engine preview (e2e or evidence screenshot)
- [ ] Remaining 33 parts unchanged; MVP demo recipe still works
- [ ] Docs note pilot vs placeholder in `adding-a-new-part.md` or `rendering.md`
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (`@typed-strict` / Boy Scout)

## Design
Epic: `.qa/design/fetz-v3-production-followups.md`

issues.title: Board thumbs: prefer engine snapshot cache
issues.body:
## Intent
Cut over Play board / bound engine-part thumbs from static registry `previewUrl` to prefer `#146` in-memory snapshot cache (`getEngineSnapshot` / `requestEngineSnapshot`), with PNG `previewUrl` fallback when cache misses.

## User Journey
1. Player builds / previews an engine and caches a snapshot (or opens preview so cache warms)
2. System stores data URL under `createRenderKey(recipe)`
3. Player sees that snapshot on bound slot / board card thumb instead of only `/cards/engine/*.png`

## Problem
`BoundCardSlot` / `BoardCard` use `resolveCardArtPath` → registry `previewUrl`. Acceptance for #146 explicitly deferred board cutover.

## Solution
Play-owned helper (near `features/play/engine3d/rendering/` or board): for engine-part defIds, if recipe snapshot exists use `dataUrl`; else `resolveEnginePartArtPath`. Wire `BoundCardSlot` / relevant board surfaces. No Feature→Feature. No offscreen WebGL in this slice — miss stays PNG. Update checklist/docs note.

## Runtime
| Axis | This slice |
|------|------------|
| Local (desktop) | yes (in-memory cache) |
| Cloud session | no |
| Appwrite Functions | skip |

## Edge Cases
- Cache miss / placeholder 1×1 → prefer PNG fallback over blank stub when detecting tiny placeholder
- Non-engine cards unchanged
- Headless tests: mock cache; no WebGL required

## Acceptance
- [ ] Bound engine-part thumbs prefer cached snapshot when `renderKey` hit
- [ ] Miss → registry/card-art PNG (no broken image)
- [ ] Vitest for resolver helper; `npm run checks` green
- [ ] Docs/`V3` or engine-system note: board cutover done
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (`@typed-strict` / Boy Scout)

## Design
Epic: `.qa/design/fetz-v3-production-followups.md`

## Runner
Labels: P0, agent-ready
Feature slug: `fetz-board-snapshot-thumbs`

issues.title: V3 Träger Ladung-Spend Confirm UI
issues.body:
## Intent
Add an explicit German Confirm UI when spending shared Fetzgerät Ladung via Träger activate paths, so charge spend is intentional (checklist: Confirm-UI für Träger-Spend fehlt).

## User Journey
1. Spieler aktiviert Träger-Effekt der Ladung kostet
2. System zeigt Confirm (Kosten + Restladung)
3. Spieler bestätigt → `dispatch`; Abbruch lässt State unverändert

## Problem
Charge pool + chip exist; accidental spend risk; gap checklist calls out missing Confirm UI.

## Solution
Play board Confirm using `components/ui` Modal/Button; wire only Träger spend / activate paths that deduct `fetzCharge`. Engine already authoritative — UI confirms before dispatch. Update gap checklist D-row.

## Runtime
| Axis | This slice |
|------|------------|
| Local (desktop) | yes |
| Cloud session | no |
| Appwrite Functions | skip |

## Edge Cases
- Insufficient charge → disabled Confirm + DE reason
- Bot path unchanged (no modal for bot)
- Cancel does not dispatch

## Acceptance

- [ ] Confirm dispatches; cancel does not
